perspective:
From Vincent’s available perspective:

- Vincent knows he is a mechanic and a long-time friend of Patrick. They met as teenagers, both work blue-collar jobs, and have collaborated before, combining Vincent’s mechanical skills with Patrick’s construction expertise.
- At the diner, Vincent learns Patrick is considering a new construction venture to expand his business. Vincent has heard it is risky. Patrick tells him it seems like a good opportunity, is worth the risk, and that he is still weighing options. Vincent worries about financial security and suggests reconsidering or delaying for more information. Patrick says he appreciates the concern and will think it over more.
- Later, Vincent notices Patrick avoiding detailed discussions about the investment. At Patrick’s construction site, Vincent tells Patrick he feels Patrick is not telling him everything and feels betrayed by the lack of transparency. Patrick says it is complicated, that he did not want to worry Vincent with details, apologizes, says he should have been more open, and offers to explain everything.
- At Vincent’s garage, during their detailed discussion, Vincent learns the situation is serious. Patrick tells him it has been tough and that he might lose a significant amount if it does not turn around soon. Vincent offers to lend Patrick money to cover short-term losses. Patrick thanks him and says he is grateful for the support.
- At the coffee shop, Vincent says it looks like the venture might turn a profit after all. Patrick says it is starting to look up and that he is relieved they stuck with it. Vincent apologizes for doubting him earlier and proposes a joint venture. Patrick agrees and says they should work out the details.
- At Vincent’s house, Vincent and Patrick are optimistic about the joint venture. Vincent says their combined skills can make it a success. He proposes drafting a business plan and outlining every step carefully. Patrick agrees and says they should cover all bases and set it up for success.

Vincent does not have access to Patrick’s private thoughts or any undisclosed details beyond what Patrick said or what Vincent directly observed.
